title: Dynamic SQL
description: Learn how to construct and execute SQL statements dynamically at runtime.

data.text: Dynamic SQL allows you to construct SQL statements at runtime. The full text of the SQL may be unknown at compilation time.

data.title: Dynamic SQL with sp_executesql parameters
data.content: Uses parameterized dynamic SQL to prevent SQL injection.

data.text: Use the QUOTENAME() function to safely quote table and schema names in dynamic SQL:

data.title: Safe dynamic SQL with QUOTENAME
data.content: Prevents SQL injection by quoting identifiers.

data.title: Dynamic SQL Key Points
points: Dynamic SQL is constructed as a string and executed at runtime.
Use sp_executesql for execution and parameterization.
Always use QUOTENAME() to prevent SQL injection.
Parameterized dynamic SQL is safer than string concatenation.
